method: §§3–5/Figure1/Algorithm1 separate execution data plane from monitor/detector/inferred failure classifier/budgeted recovery/verifier/trace. Signal, injected event and inferred cause are distinct.

Table3 maps timeout/unavailability to bounded retry/substitution/replan, schema/partial output to repair, stale context to refresh, contradiction to cross-check, loop to stop/degrade/escalate. Recovery feasibility remains bounded by authorization/tool semantics.

§5/Algorithm1 lines28–32 verify recovered state and debit recovery cost even when unsuccessful. Lines11–15 verify apparent final success; rejected verification becomes failure signal. Lines36–42 distinguish verified result, safe degraded response, escalation/termination.

Eq4/10 budgets attempts,latency,cost,depth and retry/replan/substitution/escalation dimensions. Eq9 weighted model/tool/verifier/recovery costs is formal; controlled Eq13 Ntool+Nmodel+Nverify is a call-count proxy, not actual tokens/dollars/production latency.

experiments.§6_Table4: 100 synthetic tasks,5categories×20; deterministic local tools; runtime λ0,.1,.2,.3 primary and .4,.5 stress. Seven runtime/output/context fault types. Main9000 executions; ablation9000; matched budget7200; semantic7200. Repeated deterministic seeds are not independent production workload samples.
experiments.§7.1_Tables5_6: Authors report overall selfheal98.8%,retry94.5%,simulated ReAct94.1%,fullreplan93.8%,static70.1%. Primary selfheal99.6%,stress97.3%. Cost3.25 vs3.63 ReAct/fullreplan; retry2.24/static1.61 cheaper. No local reproduction.
experiments.§7.2_Table7: Conditioned on actual injected fault, selfheal100%stale/contradiction but only79.3%timeout/75.3%unavailability. Controlled template saturation not general guarantee.
experiments.§7.3_Table8: Nonzero faults full99.3%,no classifier95.7%,no targeted recovery95.7%,relaxed budget100%; no verifier99.3% with cost2.30 vs3.30; no observability99.3% with zero traceevents. Therefore do not claim every verifier/trace adds direct task success.
experiments.§7.4_Table9: Matched budgets1,2,3,5; at1 selfheal94.0%,retry85.3%,fullreplan88.2%; at5 100/99.2/99.3. Budget1 costselfheal3.13,retry2.15,replan3.45. Targeting may help but claimed identical schedule pairing has unresolved method-dependent seed text.
experiments.§7.5_Table10: Semantic wrong-but-plausible output: verifying selfheal100%success/0%silent; nonverifying silent13.2–17.6%. No-verifier selfheal82.4%success, worse than retry85.4%. Verifier may be useful for this fault class, not universal elimination.
experiments.§7.6_Tables11_12: Compact live-model claim: main15×3×2=90,all3methods100%success; verifier ablation15×2×2=60,96.7→100%success,20→46.7%detection,16.7→46.7%recovery. Supplemental10×3×3×2=180 all100%success, so final quality saturates and cannot distinguish budget efficiency here.
experiments.§7.7_Table13: Three representative traces timeout/stale/semantic; useful qualitative diagnosis, not population incidence or statistically independent validation.

limitations: §§9.1–9.5/Table14: author-created synthetic goals/faults can align with rule policy; controlled family baselines not optimized production agents; task criteria/verifier simplify user quality, safety and ambiguity.

No production API/natural incident/real user traffic or full deployment cost validation. Local deterministic tools remain in model-in-loop. Actual tokens, long prompts, judge/verifier and human overhead require separate measurement.

§6.3 explicitly includes method in deterministic fault-seed inputs while §§6.9/8.3/9.2 claim identical paired schedules. Textual ambiguity not resolved by body; controlled notebook download rejected as too large by connector. No proved causal bias claim.

Main model-in-loop paper body lacks exact immutable model/provider version and execution manifest needed for independent reproduction. Artifact model notebook default gpt-5.4-mini is configurable and defaults FORCE_MOCK_MODEL=true/no key=>mock; saved config output empty. Do not certify published results were mock or live from that alone.

Artifact selected code finalize_row accepts judge outcome ambiguous when rule_success holds; judge JSON missing outcome defaults ambiguous, and malformed JSON can fall back to mock_judge. This is more permissive than repo independent usable-with-scope gate. No claim every published row used fallback.
Read-only tool retry tolerances do not authorize replaying purchases/messages/writes or bypassing existing cancellation, budgets, human guide, evidence and authorization fences.
